product.name: Managed BigBlueButton Hosting
product.description: A cloud-based hosting service providing access to BigBlueButton video conferencing servers with load balancing and geographic server selection to reduce latency.

product.name: BigBlueButton API Integration
product.description: An API service enabling integration of BigBlueButton video conferencing with third-party platforms and learning management systems.

product.name: Extended Recordings Service
product.description: A service providing meeting recordings in multiple formats with daily backups for later viewing and download.

product.name: Custom Room Design
product.description: A service offering customizable virtual meeting room designs with options for private designs upon request.

product.name: BiggerBlueButton Subscription Plans
product.description: Subscription-based access plans offering varying storage, user capacity, and concurrent meeting limits for the BiggerBlueButton platform.
